sections.title: Eligibility

sections.title: About IngreFit
sections.body: IngreFit is a food-information and product-analysis application. Depending on the feature and subscription level, IngreFit may allow you to: scan packaged-food barcodes; retrieve available product information; view ingredients and nutrition information; view declared allergens and “may contain” information when available; view recognized food additives; view Nutri-Score, NOVA or other third-party product classifications when available; photograph product labels for information extraction; photograph unpackaged food for approximate AI-assisted identification; select nutrition or eating goals; select dietary preferences; flag allergens or sensitivities; specify ingredients you prefer to avoid; receive a personalized product-fit score; receive AI-generated explanations and translations; maintain local scan history; and purchase optional Premium functionality. Features may vary by platform, country, App version, subscription status and technical availability.

sections.title: Informational Service Only
sections.body: IngreFit is provided solely for general informational and educational purposes. IngreFit is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. Nothing provided through IngreFit constitutes or should be interpreted as: medical advice; diagnosis; treatment; nutritional therapy; dietetic advice; allergy or intolerance diagnosis; food-safety certification; toxicological advice; emergency guidance; or other professional healthcare advice. You should consult an appropriately qualified healthcare professional for medical advice, diagnosis or treatment and before making decisions concerning a medical condition, allergy, intolerance, therapeutic diet or other health-related restriction. Never delay seeking professional medical care because of information shown by IngreFit. Do not use IngreFit in an emergency.

sections.title: Allergen and Intolerance Disclaimer
sections.body: IngreFit may flag allergens or traces that are explicitly stated in available product data or that appear in visible label text. IngreFit does not guarantee: that all allergens have been identified; that a product is free from a particular allergen; that a product is safe for a person with an allergy or intolerance; that a database record is current; that a label photograph is complete or readable; that text recognition is error-free; that AI correctly interpreted the label; that a manufacturer has not changed a recipe; that a product has not been exposed to cross-contact or cross-contamination; or that labeling or third-party database information is correct. Terms such as “blocked,” “warning,” “flagged,” “matches your restriction,” or similar interface wording indicate only that available information matched a preference or restriction selected by the user. A product that is not blocked, flagged or warned about must not be interpreted as safe, allergen-free or suitable for you. If an allergy, intolerance or medical condition could result in harm, always verify the current physical package and manufacturer information and seek qualified professional advice where appropriate.

sections.title: Food Additives and Ingredient Classifications
sections.body: IngreFit may display information or an “attention level” concerning recognized additives or ingredients. Any IngreFit additive classification is an informational categorization based on available published scientific or regulatory sources. It is not a determination that an additive, ingredient or product is: toxic; non-toxic; dangerous; harmless; safe; unsafe; carcinogenic in the amount present in the specific product; or appropriate or inappropriate for a particular individual. Scientific and regulatory assessments depend on factors such as dose, exposure, population, evidence quality, jurisdiction and evolving research. An IngreFit classification describes the informational category assigned by IngreFit and does not replace assessments by regulators, manufacturers, physicians, dietitians, toxicologists or other qualified professionals.

sections.title: Nutrition Information and Estimates
sections.body: Nutrition information may originate from a product database, visible package information or an AI-generated estimate. Database and package-declared values may be incomplete, outdated or entered incorrectly. For unpackaged foods or products for which reliable declared information is unavailable, IngreFit may display approximate AI-generated nutritional estimates. Such estimates may materially differ from the food actually consumed because of recipe, preparation method, portion size, ingredients, brand and other factors. Estimated information is not laboratory analysis and must not be treated as exact nutritional composition.

sections.title: AI-Generated Results
sections.body: Certain IngreFit features use artificial intelligence, including Google Gemini or another AI provider identified in our Privacy Policy or in-app disclosure. AI may be used for label interpretation, food identification, translation or explanatory text. Artificial intelligence can produce inaccurate, incomplete, inconsistent or misleading results, including apparently confident results that are incorrect. You are responsible for independently verifying information before relying on it. AI output must not be used as the sole basis for decisions where an error could reasonably result in injury or serious harm, including decisions concerning: severe allergies; anaphylaxis; medical treatment; medical diagnosis; therapeutic diets; medication interactions; pregnancy-related medical restrictions; emergency care; or other safety-critical circumstances. IngreFit does not use AI as a substitute for a physician, registered dietitian or other qualified professional.

sections.title: Personalized Fit Score
sections.body: IngreFit may calculate a numerical or descriptive “fit score” based on available food-product facts and preferences you select. The score is an informational personalization feature. It is not: an objective measure of whether a food is “healthy” or “unhealthy” for every person; a medical risk score; an allergy-safety score; a food-safety score; a clinical recommendation; a guarantee of health outcomes; or a regulatory certification. Different users may receive different assessments of the same product because their selected goals and preferences differ. The score is only as reliable as the underlying product information and user-selected preferences.

sections.title: Third-Party Product Information
sections.body: IngreFit may obtain product information from Open Food Facts and other sources. Open Food Facts is a third-party crowdsourced database. Third-party data may be incomplete, inaccurate, outdated or inconsistent with the product currently being sold. The physical package and current manufacturer information should be treated as the controlling sources for a specific product. References to Nutri-Score, NOVA, Open Food Facts or other third-party names, standards or classifications do not imply sponsorship, partnership or endorsement of IngreFit unless expressly stated. Third-party intellectual property remains the property of its respective owners.
